samples.title: Suburban subdivision (Las Vegas)
samples.description: Rows of single-family houses with tile roofs along curved streets, seen from straight above. The model finds most roofs; a few roofs are merged where they touch.
samples.scenario: Hip and gable roofs in a regular layout, several roof colours, swimming pools and some trees. Georeferenced: the scale comes from the file's own metadata.

samples.title: Large flat-roofed buildings (Paris area)
samples.description: Large rectangular buildings with flat roofs and strong shadows.
samples.scenario: Flat roofs, strong shadows, rooftop equipment. The model finds only part of each large roof: a harder case, shown on purpose.

samples.title: Desert edge with houses (Las Vegas)
samples.description: Houses at the edge of town with terracotta-coloured bare ground around them.
samples.scenario: A KNOWN WEAK CASE: bare soil of a similar colour to tile roofs is partly mistaken for roofs. The tool's warning about implausibly large roof coverage and the confidence map exist for cases like this.
